An '''Enforcement Station''' was an organizational level of [[Locational Enforcement/Legends|Locational Enforcement]], which was part of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. Enforcement Stations were present when a [[Market (Corporate Sector Authority)|Market]] covered more than one [[Planet/Legends|planet]], meaning a single [[Station]] would not be effective.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
